thread.title: IVV, VFMV: Big ETF Inflows

author: BNK Invest
title: IVV, VFMV: Big ETF Inflows
text:
Shutterstock photo Comparing units outstanding versus one week ago at the coverage universe of ETFs at ETF Channel, the biggest inflow was seen in the iShares Core S&P 500 ETF ( IVV ), which added 11,400,000 units, or a 2.1% increase week over week. Among the largest underlying components of IVV, in morning trading today Apple ( AAPL ) is trading flat, and Microsoft ( MSFT ) is lower by about 0.9%.
And on a percentage change basis, the ETF with the biggest increase in inflows was the Vanguard U.S. Minimum Volatility ETF ( VFMV ), which added 50,000 units, for a 28.6% increase in outstanding units.
